references.text: Reuben was Jacob's firstborn son, born to Leah. This verse confirms Reuben's status as Israel's firstborn.
The listing of Reuben's sons when Israel went down to Egypt, which forms the basis for the genealogy in Numbers.
Jacob's blessing over Reuben as his firstborn, even though he lost his birthright.
An earlier listing of Reuben's sons and their families in Exodus.
God's command to count all men twenty years old and older who could go out to war, which this verse carries out for the tribe of Reuben.
The description of how the people were registered by their clans and ancestral houses, head by head.
The second census of the tribe of Reuben forty years later, showing continuity in genealogical registration.
The genealogy of Reuben in Chronicles, confirming his position as firstborn and mentioning his descendants.
